proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derives the explicit three-term all-offset profile and four regimes, matching constant-shift, dense paired-tent and sparse fixed-cardinality lower certificates, and one full-parent-honest offset-blind interval with constant simultaneous adaptation. The mathematical and decision audits passed without findings; maximality and terminal-validity consults found no faithful same-scope route to the field floor. Downgraded at incremental tier for narrow evaluation scope and undemonstrated practical calibration; formalization was not entered, stale scope prose was reconciled, and the inaccessible SSRN comparator remains unverified.
tldr: Conditional outcome drift can erase a policy\textquotesingle s protected Bernoulli reward even when nominal success remains positive. The ambiguity family varies the conditional Bernoulli reward law with adversary-to-nominal KL at most \(\log2\) at each covariate/action pair, holding the covariate/action marginal fixed. The target is an honest confidence-length frontier for the fixed conditional-KL value \(T\), evaluated at every constant offset \(d\in[0,1/8]\) while coverage remains uniform over the entire H\"older-half parent. The central questions determine the explicit offset profile and whether one observed-data interval attains it, or must pay an unavoidable adaptation penalty. Smooth curvature and spatial excursions across saturation enter different scales of the actual root. A two-resolution confidence-inversion Handle and fixed-cardinality opposite-tent mixtures isolate that distinction in the original Bernoulli experiment. The credited flat-contact point is a boundary check; the proposed contribution requires the complete crossover and a matching common interval.
gap: Wang--Ren--Zhan--Zhou\textquotesingle s Theorem 3.5 establishes interior inference under positive-temperature regularity. It does not give a full-parent honest-length frontier as the success regression approaches conditional-KL saturation. Cai--Low--Xia supplies the individual-law length criterion in another experiment.
fill: An explicit all-offset profile, original-law lower certificates and a total common interval would determine the attainable uncertainty across that spatial contact transition. Adaptation feasibility and all logarithms are outputs, not conditions. The natural scope is a specialized inference frontier; a field-level assessment must depend on completing its nontrivial whole-offset content.
